# IQCBS

> IQCBS (Institute of Quantum Cognitive and Behavioral Sciences) is an NLP (neuro-linguistic programming) training institute at 41/3 Gariahat Road (South), Kolkata, India. Its founders, Partha Roy and Krishanu Goswami, teach NLP Practitioner and Master Practitioner certification, hypnotherapy and other change-work courses in Kolkata and live online, certified by bodies including ABNLP, ECNLP and the Society of NLP.

Key facts:

- Name: Institute of Quantum Cognitive and Behavioral Sciences (IQCBS)
- Address: 41/3 Gariahat Road (South), Kolkata 700068, West Bengal, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98319 32907, +91 83358 11194
- Email: partha@iqcbs.com
- Trainers: Partha Roy (co-founder and lead trainer) and Krishanu Goswami (co-founder and trainer)
- Certifying bodies named on the site: ABNLP, ECNLP, the Society of NLP (SNLP), the Time Line Therapy Association (TLTA) and the American Board of Hypnotherapy
- Formats: classroom in Kolkata, hybrid and live online; NLP Master Practitioners includes residential days near Kolkata
- Current dates and fees: the [dates and fees table](https://www.iqcbs.com/#dates) on the homepage, and each programme page
- NLP Practitioners is a coaching and communication qualification, not a therapy qualification

## Website

- [IQCBS homepage](https://www.iqcbs.com/): institute overview, trainers, programme dates and fees

## Programmes

- [NLP Practitioners Certification](https://www.iqcbs.com/nlp-practitioner.html): 8-day hybrid NLP Practitioner course certified by ABNLP and ECNLP, in Kolkata or live online
- [Executive NLP Practitioners](https://www.iqcbs.com/executive-nlp-practitioner.html): the same NLP Practitioner certification, taught live online over weekends
- [NLP Master Practitioners](https://www.iqcbs.com/nlp-master-practitioner.html): 10 residential days plus 4 online days, certified by ABNLP, ECNLP and SNLP; requires NLP Practitioners
- [NLP Associate Practitioners](https://www.iqcbs.com/nlp-associate-practitioner.html): 2-day ABNLP-certified workshop covering five NLP Practitioner modules
- [NLP Life Coach](https://www.iqcbs.com/nlp-life-coach.html): Society of NLP certified life coach programme for NLP Practitioners

## Specialties

- [Professional Hypnotherapist](https://www.iqcbs.com/hypnotherapy.html): hypnotherapy certification covering Ericksonian hypnosis, inductions, suggestion, self-hypnosis and script writing
- [Integral Eye Movement Techniques (IEMT)](https://www.iqcbs.com/iemt.html): IEMT Practitioner and Advanced training with Partha Roy
- [Mental Space Psychology](https://www.iqcbs.com/mental-space-psychology.html): Mental Space Psychology and Social Panorama, developed by Dr Lucas Derks, taught by Partha Roy
- [Metaphors of Movement](https://www.iqcbs.com/metaphors-of-movement.html): Level 1 and Level 2 online workshops on the metaphors people use to describe being stuck
- [The Performance Code](https://www.iqcbs.com/peak-performance.html): four evening sessions with Krishanu Goswami on focus and performance under pressure
- [Quantum Creativity](https://www.iqcbs.com/quantum-creativity.html): 18-hour online programme with Krishanu Goswami on entering the creative state on demand

## Articles

- [What is Conversational Hypnosis](https://www.iqcbs.com/blog-what-is-conversational-hypnosis.html): how hypnotic suggestions are embedded in everyday conversation
- [Sensory Acuity in NLP](https://www.iqcbs.com/blog-sensory-acuity-in-nlp-the-skill-of-noticing-what-others-miss.html): noticing small changes in another person's physiology
- [One-Word Reframing](https://www.iqcbs.com/blog-one-word-reframing-nlp.html): changing a single word to change how an experience is perceived
- [Reframing in Neuro-Linguistic Programming](https://www.iqcbs.com/blog-reframing-in-neuro-linguistic-programming-nlp.html): what reframing is, its types and its benefits
- [Metaphors of Movement](https://www.iqcbs.com/blog-metaphors-of-movement-decoding-the-symbolic-architecture-of-change.html): an introduction to the Metaphors of Movement model
- [IEMT](https://www.iqcbs.com/blog-integral-eye-movement-therapy-iemt-a-transformational-approach-to-emotional-and-identity-change.html): what IEMT is and how it uses guided eye movements
- [The Use of Metaphor As a Change Agent](https://www.iqcbs.com/blog-what-is-quantum.html): how metaphors can shift perception and support change
- [Stress](https://www.iqcbs.com/blog-what-is-the-mind.html): what stress is and ways to reduce it
- [History of Positive Psychology](https://www.iqcbs.com/blog-history-of-positive-psychology.html): the origins of positive psychology, including Martin Seligman's 1998 APA address
